rows.grounds: compound of lalāṭa varṇa rāśi sthaṃ

items.question: What must be completed in the forehead-syllable mass before the secret Kaula teaching is given?
premises: the secret teaching is not given to everyone
the teaching is to be protected
completion requires a hundred thousand repetitions
items.inference: the practitioner must complete a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the forehead-syllable mass before the worshipped god
uncertainties: the exact ritual referent of forehead-syllable-mass is unclear
items.plain_english: Having done a hundred thousand [repetitions] situated in the forehead-syllable mass, O worshipped god.
